title: Patch: a Claim all button for the news, and news and quest entries as cards
thread:
**Issue #2982 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2982: Patch: a Claim all button for the news, and news and quest entries as cards
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

Two client changes to the news (SPEC §14.13, #2875) and the quests (§14.9), on the landing's parchment panels (`landing-news-panel`, `landing-quests-panel`) and on `/collection`:

**1. Claim all for the news.** When two or more live entries are unclaimed, `NewsList` (`apps/web/src/routes/NewsPanel.tsx`) shows a **Claim all** button above the list. It claims every unclaimed entry through the existing `POST /api/news/:newsId/claim`, one at a time, newest first, each a spend with its own Idempotency-Key as today (R2875000, R2124000, R2378000). Do not add a server route. The server still decides each claim (CLAUDE.md rule 7):
- Each claim's answer replaces the list, so the bookmark's red count goes down per answer, never before it (R2875002).
- The first refusal stops the run and shows its reason in the existing `news-error` alert. Entries already claimed stay claimed.
- While the run is out, Claim all and every per-entry Claim are disabled and turning the loading wheel (`spend-wait`, `economy/spend.css`), as one claim's are now.
- `announceWallet()` fires once at the end if any Jlore was paid, not once per entry.
- With fewer than two unclaimed entries the button does not show.

The spec doesn't settle this behaviour, so it gets a ruling note in this issue's block (`spec/rulings/R<issue×1000>.md`, its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<issue>.md`, CLAUDE.md rule 3), proven by a vitest whose title has the R-id.

**2. Entries as cards.** Each news entry is currently a bare column of title, summary, reward and button (`account-quests__quest`, styled in `routes/account.css` and `routes/landing.css`). Make each entry its own card instead:
- A framed block with a light rim (`--tavern-brass`) and a slightly darker parchment fill, rounded corners and inner padding, spaced from its neighbours.
- A header row: the title on the left, and a small `Patch` / `Alert` tag from the entry's `kind` if the client already gets it (check `NewsEntry` in `net/api.ts`; don't add a field to the wire for this).
- The summary under it, wrapping normally (`overflow-wrap: anywhere` for long words) and never pushing the card wider than the panel.
- A footer row: the reward on the left as a small pill, and Claim, or the Claimed mark, on the right.
- A claimed entry fades back (lower opacity or a muted fill) so the unclaimed ones stand out.

**Use the same card for quests.** `QuestsList` (`routes/QuestsPanel.tsx`) uses the same `account-quests__quest` class, so give quests the same frame: title in the header, progress bar and "n of m" in the body, the Jlore · XP reward pill and Replace in the footer, with Replace's confirm laid out inside the card. Put the card's styles under one shared class in one place (e.g. `account-quests__quest` itself, or a new `entry-card` in a CSS file both panels import) instead of copying them between `landing.css` and `account.css`. It has to read on the landing's parchment and on `/collection`'s tavern shell, in light and dark, and at phone width (360px) with no horizontal scroll.

Keep every `data-testid` (`newsTestid`, `questsTestid`) and add `newsTestid.claimAll`. New strings go through `t()` and the i18n catalogs, as the other strings do. Any new size or count is a named constant (CLAUDE.md rule 9).

### Acceptance

- [ ] `NewsList` shows Claim all only when two or more entries are unclaimed; pressing it claims each unclaimed entry in order through `onClaim`, and the count drops per answer (vitest, extending `landing-news.test.tsx`).
- [ ] A refusal partway stops the run, shows `news-error`, and leaves the earlier claims claimed (vitest).
- [ ] While the run is out, every Claim and Claim all are disabled with `aria-busy` (vitest).
- [ ] `announceWallet` is called once for a run that paid Jlore (vitest).
- [ ] The new ruling note exists, cites §14.13, R2875000 and R2875002, lists its test in `proven_in`, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] News and quest entries render as framed cards with the header, body and footer above, on the landing and `/collection`, at desktop and 360px width, light and dark: screenshots in the pull request (`ui-walkthrough` skill).
- [ ] The existing news and quests tests (`landing-news.test.tsx`, the `QuestsPanel` tests, the e2e specs that use these testids) still pass unchanged.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web` pass.

### Blocked by, part of

Follows #2875 (the news) and #1304 (quests).
```
